title: cyclobalanopsis lineata var. oxyodon
intro: Cyclobalanopsis lineata var. oxyodon, commonly known as Chinese chinquapin, is a deciduous tree species belonging to the family Fagaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Chinese chinquapin are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which also exhibit potential in treating various diseases, including cancer and diabetes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
